mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL 12-month change > 2.5%) triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL 12-month change exceeds 2.5%, S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such months over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery (UNRATE < 6.5%), strong job growth (PAYEMS > 140000) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 6.5 and PAYEMS > 140000, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strengthening supply capacity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 450000) indicates robust retail demand, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 450000, S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such months over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: Joint increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad economic expansion across manufacturing and construction, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both INDPRO and HOUST increase in the same month, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such months over the next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation environment (CPIAUCSL 12-month change < 2.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL 12-month change < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS declines, S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances over the next 12 months.
